notice: Synthetic. Every person, company and message here is invented for tests/test_proposal_bench.py.

records.title: Halvard Freight asks for a CSV export of invoices
records.author: Ines Ferrer (Halvard Freight)
records.body:
Hello,

Our finance team copies invoices into their ledger by hand every month. Could the invoice list be exported as CSV with the same columns the screen shows? We would start the pilot next quarter if that works.

Ines

records.title: pilot sandbox resets
records.author: Devan Okoro
records.body: the pilot sandbox resets every night and the Halvard test data goes with it; they asked twice whether we can keep it for the trial

records.title: Orrin Labs: webhook retries stop too early
records.author: Tobiah Quill (Orrin Labs)
records.body: Your webhooks stop after three attempts. Our receiver is down for maintenance every Sunday and we lose the events from that window. Can retries continue for at least 24 hours?

records.title: Weekly product sync
records.author: Meret Lindqvist
records.body:
Meret: the onboarding checklist still refers to the old API key page. Three new accounts got stuck there this week. Someone needs to decide whether we redirect the old page or rewrite the checklist.
Devan: let's take that offline and come back with a proposal.
Meret: fine, but before the next batch of trials starts.

records.title: Quillon Press: audit log download for compliance
records.author: Sunniva Marsh (Quillon Press)
records.body: Our compliance review needs the audit log for the last ninety days as a file. The screen only shows thirty days. Is there a way to download the full range?

records.title: bulk import limit
records.author: Priya Vanterpool
records.body: support: two customers hit the 50-row limit on the bulk import page today and asked what the limit is for; nothing in the docs says

records.title: Brisk Tandem: dashboard signs users out too early
records.author: Caspian Rowe (Brisk Tandem)
records.body: Our users get signed out of the dashboard after fifteen minutes of inactivity. Their SSO session lasts eight hours. The mismatch is the top complaint from our team leads.

records.title: nightly report job
records.author: Devan Okoro
records.body: eng: the nightly report job failed twice this week because the export bucket ran out of space; the customer-facing report was late both times and two tickets came in

records.title: Re: last week's fix
records.author: Ines Ferrer (Halvard Freight)
records.body: Thanks for the quick fix last week, all good now on our side.

records.title: team lunch
records.author: Priya Vanterpool
records.body: lunch is at noon on Thursday, the usual place

records.title: Orrin Labs: audit log timezone
records.author: Tobiah Quill (Orrin Labs)
records.body: Quick one: which timezone does the audit log use? Our analysts compare it with their own logs.

records.title: Audit log timestamps
records.author: Meret Lindqvist
records.body: Audit log timestamps are stored and shown in UTC; the export carries an offset column for local time.
